fee_notes: The Initial Franchise Fee is variable based on Territory population (calculated at $0.10 per person), typically ranging from $40,000 to $80,000 for territories of 400,000–800,000 people. During the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, the fee actually ranged from $39,304 to $80,000. A 10% discount is available for qualified veterans (honorable discharge per DD214). Existing franchisees signing an additional Franchise Agreement receive a 20% reduction. A separate non-refundable Business Administration Set-Up Fee (BASF) of $10,000 is also required at signing (waived for existing franchisees adding a territory). The Initial Franchise Fee is generally non-refundable, except that if the franchisor terminates due to failed training, it retains 50%–75% of the fee for its direct/indirect expenses and returns the remainder.
